name: r-simulation-methods
description: ADEMP-based Monte Carlo study design, SimDesign execution, explicit failure accounting, and performance evaluation with Monte Carlo uncertainty.

interface.shortDescription: Design and evaluate reproducible Monte Carlo studies.
interface.longDescription: Plan research simulations with ADEMP and implement small, transparent SimDesign experiments. Preserve method failures, explicit performance denominators, Monte Carlo uncertainty, and reproducible seed provenance.
defaultPrompt: Plan this Monte Carlo comparison using ADEMP and a defensible precision budget.
Implement a small SimDesign study that keeps failed fits in its attempt counts.
Review these simulation summaries, denominators, MCSEs and replay seeds.
